abort_reason: Every completed request returned HTTP 400 before a model response because the frozen Vertex-oriented response schema exceeded the Gemini Developer API schema compiler's accepted complexity.

diagnosis.method: Content-free text-only field isolation; response bodies and generated text were not persisted.
diagnosis.finding: The Developer API accepts responseJsonSchema with at most 64 line items and a fixed four-integer bbox array when bbox coordinate range constraints are enforced by the unchanged local strict parser rather than the wire schema.

usage.note: HTTP 400 responses supplied no usage metadata. Small content-free diagnostic requests were outside the formal measurement and were not billed-evidence reconciled.

decision: This attempt is infrastructure-invalid and supplies no OCR capability result. The original preregistration remains immutable; a separately hashed v2 preregistration is required before retrying.
